notes: The zip is extracted to a disposable temp directory, then unwrapped exactly once if it produced one subdirectory and zero loose top-level files (`subdirs.count == 1 && files.isEmpty`) before scanServerDirectory ever runs — this specific unwrap-and-scan sequence lives in AddServerWizardView.performScan (line 2179-2196), not in AppViewModel+ServerImport.swift. An almost identical private helper, resolvedImportDir (AppViewModel+ServerImport.swift:478-494), duplicates the same `subdirs.count == 1 && files.isEmpty` check for the mutating import path instead. P5.19's read-only scanner should port performScan's version of this rule, since P5.18 characterizes the read-only half; P5.20 (the mutating importer) is where resolvedImportDir's copy is the relevant oracle. If the zip had produced more than one top-level entry, no unwrap happens and the scan runs at the archive root as-is — not separately fixtured, since the rule itself is the one-line condition at the cited source line.
